sources.title: Security researchers tricked LLMs into giving them cocaine recipes by ...
sources.snippet: AI models provide responses to user-supplied prompts. The problem is that AI models may receive adversarial prompts - directly from a user or indirectly from an ingested document - that tell the model to take action contrary to its built-in system prompt.
